Updated, 8.45am HKT: Proton now says: "This incident is now largely resolved, and services are back online. However, we are still working through a small number of residual issues, so some users may experience delays in sending/receiving email and notifications. No data loss has been caused as a result of this incident." Original story follows.

Proton has confirmed a major outage affecting Proton Mail, Proton VPN, Lumo and other platforms and services. Here's what we know.

Proton is working to fix it

Earlier tonight, Proton's status page confirmed a major outage affecting the following services:

  • Proton Mail
  • Proton VPN
  • Proton Calendar
  • Proton Drive
  • Proton Pass
  • SimpleLogin
  • Proton Wallet
  • Lumo by Proton

The company says that after initial investigation and mitigation, all issues are now being treated as partial outages. A status update posted at 7.37am HKT reads:

The outage was first confirmed at 6.09am HKT, when outage reports began increasing on Downdetector. Users on X also reported issues, prompting a response from the company:

We're monitoring the issues and will update this post when we have more information or when the issues are marked as resolved.
